name: 全身性肥満細胞症

summary.text: A heterogeneous group of rare, acquired and chronic hematological malignancies related to an abnormal accumulation/proliferation of neoplastic mast cells (MCs) in one or several organs, mainly the bone marrow (BM), associated frequently with skin involvement.
